title: ACDF PolicySpec (off-chain descriptor mirror)
description: JSON mirror of the on-chain PolicySpec struct of the Agent Collective Decision Framework reference v0.2. The on-chain struct is the normative object: policyId = keccak256(abi.encode(PolicySpec)). This descriptor exists so that implementers in other languages can reproduce the encoding (see vectors/policy-id.json). Any field here that is not part of the hashed struct is marked informative.

family.description: Policy family id; the first version claims it and fixes who may publish later versions.

previous.description: policyId of the previous version in the family; zero for the first version.

updateAuthority.description: Account allowed to publish the next version of the family.

nodes.description: nodes[0] is the root. Every edge points to a strictly larger index (acyclic) and every non-root node is referenced exactly once (a tree).

maxAppeals.description: Extra rounds allowed after the first.

appealWindow.description: Seconds after a round's result instant during which an appeal may be filed. Must be > 0 when maxAppeals > 0.

appealable.description: Bitmask: 1 = Decided results appealable, 2 = NoDecision results appealable.

appealMode.description: PRESERVE_UNLESS_OVERTURNED: an appeal round that ends in NoDecision leaves the decision under appeal standing. REQUIRE_FRESH_DECISION: opening an appeal vacates the earlier decision; only the last round's own decision can be adopted, otherwise the issue ends in NoDecision. No kernel default: every policy states its mode.

maxTotalDuration.description: Hard cap from admission, in seconds. Must be >= (maxAppeals + 1) * roundDuration + maxAppeals * appealWindow, where roundDuration is the longest body window.

ackWindow.description: POST_ACK acknowledgment window in seconds; 0 disables POST_ACK for this policy.

allowAdvisory.description: Whether an unacknowledged POST_ACK issue may be admitted as Advisory after the window.

descriptorHash.description: Hash of the human-readable descriptor. Informative: it is part of the hashed struct but never influences execution.

acceptance.description: Result-acceptance mode of THIS body. ROSTER_KOFN bodies use ON_CHAIN_TALLY or SIGNED_BALLOTS; AUTHORIZED_SUBMITTER bodies use AUTHORIZED_SUBMITTER.

members.description: ROSTER_KOFN: unique, non-zero roster. AUTHORIZED_SUBMITTER: exactly one pinned submitter.

k.description: ROSTER_KOFN: approvals needed, 1 <= k <= N; N-k+1 blocks decide No. Ignored for AUTHORIZED_SUBMITTER.

window.description: Seconds from round start during which this body accepts input; > 0.

k.description: KOFM: required child approvals, 1 <= k <= children.length.

target.description: VETO: index of the guarded node (> own index).

vetoBody.description: VETO: index of the veto body; its window is the veto window. An approve ballot in that body means VETO; an explicit block decision means CLEARANCE.

silence.description: VETO: what the veto body's silence means once its window closes.

children.description: ALL / ANY / KOFM: child node indices (> own index, unique).
